requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4314-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4314-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4247-4488-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3025-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

997-4186-6012--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7934.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Federation Field Medic.
When Federation Field Medic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Federation Field Medic enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1315-5233-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Repeat.

1003-3558-6516-7735.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-3558-6516-7735.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

670-1619-6139-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6139-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Caves of Chaos Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Caves of Chaos Adventurer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

539-2034-5003-7705.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 Minion creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7640.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

465-4050-4681.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-6158-6528.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-6158-6528.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

539-3784-4657.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Vhal.
Repeat.

1497-5220-6559-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3967-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
3967-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

779-4970-5751-6289.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

851-2157-2598.manaNeeded: {3}{W} plus commander tax if applicable the first turn, and {4}{G}{U} the second turn
851-2157-2598.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using The Sixth Doctor this turn.
851-2157-2598.description:
Cast Romana II either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, creating a token copy of Romana II that isn't legendary.
During another turn, cast Adrix and Nev by paying {2}{G}{U}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, creating a token copy of Adrix and Nev that isn't legendary.
Resolve the Adrix and Nev spell.
Activate a Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating four token copies of the Adrix and Nev token that aren't legendary.
Activate the other Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating 64 token copies of the Adrix and Nev token that aren't legendary.
Whenever you create a token from this point on, you will create 2^70 times as many of those tokens due to the 70 Adrix and Nev's you control.

2351-4639-6237.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Field Surgeon by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Field Surgeon ability.
Repeat.

2034-2820-4679-5223.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

360-2919-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
360-2919-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

2-1270-4659-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2011-3699-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Cadira does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least five tokens.
2011-3699-4050.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Cadira.
Cadira triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Rabbits, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If you control six or more tokens when Cadira deals combat damage, this combo nets infinite Rabbit tokens and colored mana.

2707-3786-4872.notablePrerequisites: Ardent Dustspeaker does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2707-3786-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Ardent Dustspeaker as an attacker.
Ardent Dustspeaker triggers, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard, then exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them this turn.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

841-2292-4544-5310.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2292-4544-5310.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Bloodghast.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing Bloodghast to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Bloodghast trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

2019-2773-2906-5147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Rakdos.
2019-2773-2906-5147.description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Warstorm Surges triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to command zone.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

176-2438-3000.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-2438-3000.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

224-2248-3861.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.
